The following events took place in '''161 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Tarasin Revolt]] begins on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Tarasin Revolt date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' mentions that the Tarasin Revolt began 129 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. It can therefore be deduced that the revolt started in 161 BBY.</ref>
